the husband. the wife. her sister. his friend.

They're selling music but not selling out.

Dr. Choma Kruvajan / Dr. Thomas Kruvajan

The Man Who Refused To Surrender

Govindarajan Ramaswamy / Rangaraja Nambi / George W. Bush / Avtaar Singh / Balram Naidu / Christian Fletcher / Shinghen Narahasi / Krishnaveni / Vincent Poovaragavan / Kalifullah Mukhtaar

Greater Than "Cimarron" - Packed with Thrills - Loaded with Action . . . As an Exciting page from American history is unfolded upon the screen !

32288: Over a 5-year period in Bridgend in Wales, 79 people, many of them teenagers, committed suicide without leaving any clue as to why. This is the starting point for this mysterious social drama.
32544: In a small village, a lonely fisherman yearning for a son is drawn to an ethereal light that links him to others and their long-buried secrets.

Leroy Jones / Rufus Jones / Rev. Lenox Thomas

Was The SIXTH MAN The Secret To The Five Empty Graves?...the Answer waited in a woman's lips and watched from the shadows of a frightened town!

The moment you feel that love has come this far.

37920: A feature documentary about the life of Lenny McLean, as seen through the eyes of his only son, Jamie.
38176: A woman who is tormented by the ghost of her abusive, alcoholic husband. She must come to terms with the past if she is to find peace and love...

Where will the road take her?

The greatest saga of all times.
38944: A Korean War veteran's morphine addiction wreaks havoc upon his family.
The tender love story of Johnny Pope, husband, brother, father-to-be!

They came out of the grave... to get REVENGE!

An Equation That Changed All Other Equations

The conflict of a love triangle

The true story of America's most notorious exorcist.

A journey that will not be easy.

More perverted than FRENZY... Bloodier than PSYCHO... More sadistic than BLUEBEARD!

43808: Three impoverished roommates have the chance to change their fates when one of them stumbles upon a seemingly low-risk way to earn some extra cash.

44832: A reworking of A Christmas Carol where the protagonist is a typical Karen.

Save the last bullet for yourself.

The Swiss answer to American Pie

It's about the first time you fall in love.

Gathered by heart, recycled for love.

His greatest weapon was a pen; his greatest flaw was his honesty

26.5 million reasons to break the rules.

Love battling against the sorcery of the jungle!

51744: A band of adventurers invade a native island determined to grab a reported fortune in buried treasure.
Forgotten by nature... invaded by modern man... half human... half fish!
